title: USA Rare Earth, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026 disclosing that two board members will not stand for reelection at the June 3, 2026 annual meeting, reducing the board to six directors. The company also announced a definitive merger agreement with SVRE Holdings Ltd. and Serra Verde Rare Earths Ltd., expected to close in Q3 2026, which will add two directors to the board.
key_points: Two board members (Mordechai Gutnick and General Paul Kern) notified the board on April 20, 2026 they will not stand for reelection at the June 3, 2026 annual meeting
Board size will be reduced to six directors effective immediately before the annual meeting
Company entered into a merger agreement on April 19, 2026 with SVRE Holdings Ltd. and Serra Verde Rare Earths Ltd.
Merger expected to close in Q3 2026 subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals
Upon closing, board will expand from six to eight directors with two nominees from Serra Verde Rare Earths Ltd.
Company is registered on Nasdaq under ticker USAR
